title: Radios
summary: Bluetooth: bluez, bluetoothctl and the Bluetooth service, with rfkill to see and free a radio switch. Kept apart from the SDR and LoRa tools of the Radio toolkit.
consent: bluez runs the Bluetooth service on the box. A device that pairs can use it until it is removed. The toolkit starts the service and leaves it on.
notes: bluetoothctl lists the adapter, scans, pairs and connects. rfkill lists the radio switches and unblocks one that is off.
This toolkit is for Bluetooth. The Radio toolkit has the SDR, APRS and LoRa tools, and Meshtastic radios use meshtasticd and the Meshtastic page.
The Box doctor checks Bluetooth only while bluetooth.service runs.
